name: Build A Boat
desc:
🌊 Welcome to Build A Boat

Make your very own boat, navigate through wild and crazy obstacles and sail across procedurally generated biomes! 🏝️

🦈 Survive crazy obstacles and explore wild biomes!
⛵ Build your dream boat using blocks from the shop!
🚀 Launch and earn cash to upgrade your boat!
⚡ Get rare and unique blocks, each with its very own mutations!

⭐ Remember, your boat literally sails offline!
